item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 10/Dec/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the northeast monsoon moderating gradually today and tomorrow, temperatures over Guangdong will rise slightly. Another surge of the northeast monsoon will reach the coast of Guangdong on Wednesday night. Under the persistent influence of the monsoon in the latter part of this week to early next week, temperatures over the coastal areas of Guangdong will fall progressively, it will be rather cool in the morning and at night. It will be cold over the inland areas. The northeast monsoon is expected to moderate progressively midweek next week, the weather over southern China will become fine and dry, and daytime temperature will rise.
